name: com.catsplatstudios.adsmediation
description: A thin layer over Unity LevelPlay. Game code depends on one small interface for banner, interstitial and rewarded ads, while LevelPlay does the mediation. Ads load themselves, and a fake implementation makes game logic easy to test.

samples.description: A scene with buttons for every ad format and banner position, a composition root, and game logic tested with a fake ad service.
